WITH reserved AS (
  INSERT INTO automation_delivery_log (event_key, workflow, recipient, status)
  VALUES ($1, 'task-reminder', $2, 'processing')
  ON CONFLICT (event_key) DO UPDATE
  SET status = 'processing', updated_at = NOW(), sent_at = NULL, error_message = NULL
  WHERE automation_delivery_log.status = 'failed'
     OR (automation_delivery_log.status = 'processing' AND automation_delivery_log.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes')
  RETURNING event_key
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved) AS reserved,
  $1::text AS event_key,
  $2::text AS email,
  $3::text AS subject,
  $4::text AS html;

UPDATE automation_delivery_log
SET
  status = CASE WHEN $2 = '' THEN 'sent' ELSE 'failed' END,
  updated_at = NOW(),
  sent_at = CASE WHEN $2 = '' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
  error_message = NULLIF($2, '')
WHERE event_key = $1
RETURNING event_key, status, sent_at, error_message;
